design: natural 2x2: net/storage direction (up/down) x inflow trend (up/down)
recognition_gate: net-flow direction correct under all 2 column orders x 2 option orders
primary_outcome: stock-up probability averaged across column and stock-option orders
primary_inflow_attraction: mean of aligned-minus-conflict stock-up probability for net-up and conflict-minus-aligned stock-up probability for net-down
fatal_controls: official metric units only; no unit inference
strict closure and rounded-prompt net-sign checks
negative inflow or outflow observations are excluded
non-overlapping source selection with dam-cluster inference
net recognition gate precedes stock analysis
formula reminder tests whether explicit integration removes attraction
